prompt:
The section sections/newsletter-perks-sentence.liquid currently renders an optional title, a
    of every block's text, and a subscribe button. Replace the
      with a natural-language sentence built from the perk blocks only. Keep the title and button behavior exactly as it is now. The {% schema %}...{% endschema %} block must stay byte-for-byte unchanged. Inputs: - section.settings.title: string or null. - section.settings.button_label: string or null. - section.blocks: an array, possibly empty. Each block is an object with: - type: string, either "perk" or "note". - settings.text: string or null. This key is always present. Rules: 1. Title (unchanged). If title is neither null nor the empty string, output

      TITLE

      with the text HTML-escaped. Otherwise output no h2. 2. Valid perks. A valid perk is a block whose type is exactly "perk" and whose settings.text is non-empty after stripping leading and trailing whitespace. A null text counts as empty. Blocks of any other type are ignored completely, and so are perks with empty text. 3. Sentence. If there is at least one valid perk, output

      Subscribe and get LIST.

      . LIST contains each valid perk in block order as TEXT, where TEXT is the stripped, HTML-escaped text. Separators: - Between the second-to-last and the last valid perk, use " and ". - Between all other consecutive valid perks, use ", ". - There is no Oxford comma. - With exactly one perk there is no separator. - The sentence ends with a single "." right after the last . Note that the last valid perk is not necessarily the last block, because ignored blocks may follow it. If there are no valid perks, output no

      at all. 4. Button (unchanged). Output . LABEL is button_label HTML-escaped, or Subscribe when button_label is null or the empty string. 5. Wrapper and ordering. Everything is wrapped in

      ...
      , in this order: h2, p, button. 6. Whitespace. Emit no whitespace or newlines between or around tags. Spaces occur only inside the sentence text as specified. Example: with perks "A", "B", "C" the sentence is Subscribe and get A, B and C. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Preserve the entire schema block byte-for-byte. Change only sections/newsletter-perks-sentence.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
